summary: Example task gets version info on NOS with nos_command and registers it.
questions: How do I get version info from Extreme NOS?

answer_card.title: Get Extreme NOS version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Get version information (nos)
  community.network.nos_command:
    commands: "show version"
  register: show_ver
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.nos'
```
